features.quote: Model explicitly states it cannot complete the task (abandonment)
Model produces identical output to previous iteration with no new reasoning (loop detection)
Model produces a response with no tool calls and no plan (stall)
A significant methodological risk: some model behavior that looks like "premature abandonment" is actually correct assessment of an unsolvable task.
features.justification_quote: High-quality models may score high on accurate diagnosis AND low on self-flagellation — a desirable pattern you'd miss without this.
